editorial:
Imagine you are finally happy with your girlfriend, but then a girl from your past suddenly shows up and flips your world upside down. That is exactly what happens to Sakuta. You get to see his sweet relationship with Mai, but things get complicated when Shoko, his first crush, appears out of nowhere. The movie feels like a warm hug at first, but it quickly turns into an emotional rollercoaster. It mixes everyday high school life with some strange, supernatural twists that make you wonder what is actually real and what is just a dream.

What really hits home is how the movie handles sadness and sacrifice. The twists are a total shock, and the voice acting makes you feel every single emotion. While the plot can get a bit confusing with the time-travel stuff, the payoff is worth it. If you want a good cry, you should definitely watch this. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a big fan of the series, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: You find out that the young Shoko is actually a future version of herself who traveled back in time. She wants to save her younger self from a tragic accident. To make this happen, Sakuta has to make a heartbreaking choice. He eventually manages to change the timeline so that everyone survives. In the end, he forgets Shoko, but a random encounter on the street brings back his memories, giving them a happy second chance.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural romance and stories that make them cry.
